assessments.reasoning: Section 4.4.4.4 returns the previous page count on successful growth and -1 on either failure branch. Its note permits failure inside the maximum. The actual growth helper adds the delta to current pages and checks both the Core 1.0 cap and any declared maximum against that resulting count.

challenge.method: Compare the reduction, the note and the growing-memory helper. Probe zero delta, growth to the declared maximum, a one-page delta after reaching maximum, and a large unsigned delta. Check whether any successful attempt below the cap entails guaranteed success.
challenge.results: At a maximum of two pages, a delta of one fails after reaching two even though the delta alone is smaller than the maximum. The frozen wording refers to the resulting requested page count. Resource-induced in-range failure follows from the governing reduction and was not forced in the probe.

limitations: The return is the core instruction’s i32 result. Host API behavior and resource policy are separate. The growth helper independently enforces the Core 1.0 page limit.

Exact dated publications govern the scope. The independently constructed current-engine cases are a supplementary challenge. The maximum applies to the resulting total page count. Resource-induced in-range failure was assessed directly from the published reduction.
